mapper.select:
select o.orgname as UnitDeptidName,g.orgname as CreateDeptidName,a.ORGNAME as CreateUnitidName ,s.REALNAME as CreateStaffidName,k.risknumber as risknumber,r.* from TBL_RISK_MONTHLY_EVALUATION r left join TBL_ORGANIZATION o on r.UNIT_DEPTID=o.ORGID left join TBL_ORGANIZATION g on r.CREATE_DEPTID=g.ORGID left join TBL_ORGANIZATION a on r.CREATE_UNITID=a.ORGID left join TBL_STAFF s on r.CREATE_STAFFID=s.STAFFID left join tbl_risk k on k.riskid=r.riskid where r.status=6
and a.orgname LIKE concat(concat('%',#{queryParam.createUnitidName} ),'%')
and o.orgname LIKE concat(concat('%',#{queryParam.unitDeptidName} ),'%')
and year(r.create_Time)=#{queryParam.year}
and r.ONE_RISK LIKE concat(concat('%',#{queryParam.oneRisk} ),'%')
and r.TWO_RISK LIKE concat(concat('%',#{queryParam.twoRisk} ),'%')
and r.THREE_RISK LIKE concat(concat('%',#{queryParam.threeRisk} ),'%')
and k.risknumber LIKE concat(concat('%',#{queryParam.risknumber} ),'%')
and r.month >= #{queryParam.monthL}
and r.month <= #{queryParam.monthR}
${sql} order by id,r.CREATE_UNITID desc
